mapper.select: select id, module, title, description, due_on, point_reward, status from growth_task where created_by = #{teacherId} order by due_on
mapper.insert: insert into growth_task(module, title, description, due_on, point_reward, status, created_by) values (#{module}, #{title}, #{description}, #{dueOn}, #{pointReward}, 'PUBLISHED', #{createdBy})
insert ignore into student_task(task_id, student_id, status) values (#{taskId}, #{studentId}, 'ASSIGNED')
mapper.select: select st.id, st.student_id, st.status, st.completed_on, st.teacher_note, s.name as student_name from student_task st join student s on s.id = st.student_id join class_room c on c.id = s.class_id where st.task_id = #{taskId} and c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}
select st.student_id, g.point_reward, g.title from student_task st join growth_task g on g.id = st.task_id where st.id = #{studentTaskId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into point_ledger(student_id, amount, category, reason, idempotency_key, created_by) values (#{studentId}, #{amount}, 'TASK', #{reason}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{actor})
mapper.update: update student_task set teacher_note = #{note} where id = #{studentTaskId}
mapper.select: select id, module, title, point_reward, status from growth_task where id = #{taskId}
